verdict.rationale: The Division documents a registered-agent role that companies can name and change on the public record. It also documents a Premier Business Services account for businesses that frequently use the formation service, with staff access to a shared payment account. Together these give a partial sanctioned third-party channel, but neither is explicitly described as authorizing an outside provider to file on the company's behalf. Missing for 10: an explicit authorized-provider or designee program, documentation of what a registered agent or representative may do for the company, PBS delegation details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Change your registered agent name and/or address
with your current officers/members, main business address and registered agent
If your business frequently uses the Business Formation online service or needs to provide staff access to use a shared payment account to submit filings
